title: Vihusishi (Theme 2: Mazoezi ya viungo vya mwili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child gives -a unganifu the prefix of the first noun (kitabu cha, vitabu vya, nyumba ya) and uses relating words of cause (kwa sababu ya, kutokana na).
steps: For cause: kwa sababu ya, kutokana na.

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "kwa sababu ya" and "viungo vya mwili".

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi cha -a unganifu?" Kwa nini "kwa sababu ya" si jibu sahihi?
Soma tena: "Ni kihusishi kipi cha sababu?" Kwa nini "cha" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Kwa sababu ya ni kihusishi cha sababu.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Kamilisha: kitabu ___ mwalimu." Kwa nini "wa" si jibu sahihi?
Nomino ya kwanza iko katika ngeli ipi?
misconceptions.repair: Kiunganishi -a hupatana na nomino ya kwanza: viungo vya mwili.
